latest_market_signal.signal_reason: Signal only; no orders are sent by this version
latest_market_signal.risk_reason: No qualifying BUY or SELL signal.
latest_market_signal.risk_decision_scope: Exchange-account candidate check only; it does not control the offline paper simulator.
latest_market_signal.paper_trading_mode: Independent simulated position; no exchange order is sent.
latest_market_signal.note: Signal from retrieved market data. Paper simulation uses its own hypothetical position and is independent of real BTC/USDT account balances. No exchange order was sent.

experimental_learning_model.brier_score_note: Lower is better; 0 is perfect and 0.25 is the reference score for constant 0.5 probabilities on a balanced binary target.
experimental_learning_model.signal_reason: Experimental model probability crossed the BUY threshold.
experimental_learning_model.evaluation_method: Chronological 80/20 holdout; features use current/past candles only.
experimental_learning_model.safety_note: Experimental research output only. Model signal does not control paper trades or submit exchange orders. Holdout results are not proof of profitability; fees, slippage and regime changes are not fully modelled.

walk_forward_evaluation.gate_note: This report-only gate is not connected to order placement. Real-money use remains disabled and would require positive after-cost results across multiple distinct unseen periods, realistic execution assumptions, and independent review.
walk_forward_evaluation.position_strategy_method: Long-only Spot simulation, one position at a time. Entry at signal candle close; every later candle OHLC is checked for stop-loss/take-profit even if a prediction is missing. If both stop and target are touched in one candle, stop-loss is assumed first. A candle opening below the stop is filled at its open, not the stop level. Estimated fees/slippage included; no account balance, exchange execution, or orders.
walk_forward_evaluation.threshold_tuning_method: At each walk-forward step, compare fixed BUY thresholds on an inner chronological validation slice from that step's training data only. A candidate must have at least five trades, positive average net return after estimated costs, and beat the same-window all-candle baseline after costs; otherwise fall back to ML_BUY_THRESHOLD. The later walk-forward prediction is not used to select its threshold. This remains exploratory and may overfit validation.
walk_forward_evaluation.trade_test_method: Each BUY prediction is a hypothetical one-candle Spot long, entered at that candle close and exited at the next close. Each trade uses a fixed stake; actual portfolio allocation, idle cash, and order execution are not simulated.
walk_forward_evaluation.buy_only_drawdown_method: Sequential fixed-stake trade PnL peak-to-trough; excludes idle cash, overlapping positions, and portfolio sizing.
caveats: Research-only estimate; not proof of future profitability.
Fixed-stake PnL assumes the stated stake is deployed for every BUY signal; it does not model a real account balance or position sizing.
Compounded returns are illustrative only and are not a portfolio-level backtest; they should not be treated as expected account returns.
Order-book depth, spread variation, partial fills, idle cash, and taxes are not modelled.
Fee and slippage assumptions may differ from actual Bitget account costs.
SELL predictions are reported but this Spot test does not short-sell.
Position-based stop-loss/take-profit simulation uses candle OHLC; intrabar ordering is unknown and stop-loss-first is assumed when both levels are touched.
No exchange account is accessed and no orders are submitted.

Threshold tuning uses only each fold's training period and rejects candidate thresholds without positive average validation return after estimated costs, but repeated comparisons can still overfit; validate across more symbols and later unseen periods before any live use.

probability_band_after_cost_analysis.method: Descriptive grouping of chronological out-of-sample predictions. Bands are not selected using test outcomes; returns represent one-candle hypothetical fixed-stake trades with estimated entry/exit fees and slippage. Small band counts are noisy.

holding_period_cost_analysis.method: Uses only chronological walk-forward out-of-sample BUY signals. For each horizon, trades are non-overlapping and exit at the close N candles after entry. Entry/exit fees and slippage are included. No thresholds are tuned on these results; this diagnostic does not authorize orders.

bullish_regime_filter_comparison.filter_definition: Keep baseline BUY signals only when current-candle sma_gap_20 > 0 (close above the 20-period moving average proxy).
bullish_regime_filter_comparison.interpretation: Compare after-cost PnL and drawdown as well as trade count. Fewer trades or higher win rate alone is not evidence of a better strategy.

multi_period_evaluation.benchmark_interpretation: A model is more convincing when directional accuracy beats the training-fold majority baseline and selected BUY returns beat the same-period one-candle always-buy benchmark after estimated fees and slippage. Counts show consistency across periods, not proof of future performance.
multi_period_evaluation.method: The available candle history is split into disjoint chronological periods. Each period is evaluated with its own expanding walk-forward training and later test predictions; fees and slippage are included. This is a research screen, not proof of future profitability.
multi_period_evaluation.note: This report-only evaluation never enables live trading and never submits exchange orders.

cost_assumptions.note: Estimated costs are not actual Bitget fills. Closed-trade estimates cover the trades retained in paper state; cumulative gross realized PnL may include older trades no longer retained.

note: Simulated results only. Paper positions are hypothetical and independent of real exchange balances. No exchange order is sent. Gross and estimated net PnL are reported separately.
